umn Entertainment GmbH

/ˈhjuːmən/

umn.

/ˌhjuːmən/

Pronounced like “human”. A reminder of what sits at the centre of our work: the artist, first.

Who we are.

One platform. Management, label and publishing under one roof.

umn is a management platform with its own label and publishing infrastructure underneath it, founded in Berlin by three executives with more than 50 years of combined experience in the global music business. Behind them is a team of senior specialists covering every part of an artist’s business.

Our Philosophy.

Artists today are entrepreneurs, brands and rights owners.

We believe a career has to be built around each artist’s own goals – not around the business models of labels, platforms or anyone else involved.

That is why we work as partners alongside our artists: they set the goal, together we set the strategy and execute it.

What we do.

More options, more complexity. That is what we take on.

Artists’ options have multiplied in every part of the business – from releasing music to reaching their fans, from touring to building a brand, and from owning their rights to owning their business. But more options mean more complexity – more platforms, partners, data, and decisions. Turning that into a successful career takes professional management, built to handle this complexity locally and globally. That is what we do.

Artists.

Distinct voices. Different paths. Moving forward together.
